summary: Senseonics Holdings, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a follow-on offering of 8,000,000 common shares and pre-funded warrants to purchase 8,000,000 shares at a public offering price of $5.00 per share ($4.999 per pre-funded warrant), raising approximately $75.2 million in net proceeds. The offering is an ordinary equity capital raise under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation. The company is a smaller reporting company. Joint book-running managers are TD Cowen and Barclays. The offering is expected to close on or about May 4, 2026.
